full_text:
Frostanna is a Litho-Titan used by Ford. Also known as the Snow Lady, she can control ice, freezing water particles in the air through her hair and generating cooling rays from her long claws.

History

Frostanna was first used by Ford to freeze and capture Gil in Tel Aviv. [The Fire of Georgiopolis]

In Venice, Italy, Ford summoned her to attack Lok when he attempted to obtain the medallion of Saint Mark. [The Carnival of Deception]

Frostanna was invoked by Ford to attack Lok but she was defeated by Headless Hessian. [The Headless Horseman]

Ford invoked Fostanna who attacked the Huntik team and froze Lok, Dante and Sophie. She searched for Zhalia Moon but did not see her suspended on the ceiling. [The Curse of Venice]

After Ford joined the Huntik Foundation, Frostanna used was against the Organization.

Frostanna was later invoked fight alongside Ignatius against Lee Roy's Executioner. [The Titan of the Stage]

Abilities

Frostanna can fire Ice Blasts and can easily freeze or trap her foes in ice. She is quick and nimble so she can dodge attacks or pursue a target. In addition, she can also float around, giving her added mobility advantages over her enemies.

Gallery

Image caption: Frostanna's Amulet

Trivia

• Frostanna is based off the Yuki-onna or "snow woman", beautiful ice spirits from Japanese mythology.

}}'''Frostanna''' is a Litho-Titan used by [[Ford]]. Also known as the Snow Lady, she can control ice, freezing water particles in the air through her hair and generating cooling rays from her long claws.

== History ==
Frostanna was first used by Ford to freeze and capture [[Gil]] in Tel Aviv. {{Source|The Fire of Georgiopolis}}

In [[Venice, Italy]], Ford summoned her to attack [[Lok]] when he attempted to obtain the medallion of Saint Mark. {{Source|The Carnival of Deception}}

Frostanna was invoked by Ford to attack Lok but she was defeated by [[Headless Hessian]]. {{Source|The Headless Horseman}}

Ford invoked Fostanna who attacked the Huntik team and froze [[Lok]], [[Dante]] and [[Sophie]]. She searched for [[Zhalia Moon]] but did not see her suspended on the ceiling. {{Source|The Curse of Venice}}

After Ford joined the [[Huntik Foundation]], Frostanna used was against the [[Organization]].

Frostanna was later invoked fight alongside [[Ignatius]] against [[Lee Roy]]'s [[Executioner]]. {{Source|The Titan of the Stage}}

== Abilities ==
Frostanna can fire Ice Blasts and can easily freeze or trap her foes in ice. She is quick and nimble so she can dodge attacks or pursue a target. In addition, she can also float around, giving her added mobility advantages over her enemies.
